CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION uqn_fix.hkm30_norm(t text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE AS $f$
  SELECT btrim(
    regexp_replace(
      regexp_replace(
        translate(regexp_replace(t, '[\u0610-\u061A\u064B-\u065F\u0670\u06D6-\u06ED\u0640]', '', 'g'), 'أإآٱؤئةى', 'ااااويهي'),
        '[^[:alpha:][:digit:][:space:]\u0660-\u0669\u06F0-\u06F9\u00B2\u00B3\u00B9\u00BC-\u00BE\u2070-\u2079\u2080-\u2089\u2150-\u2189\u2460-\u249B\u24EA-\u24FF\u2776-\u2793]', ' ', 'g'),
      '[[:space:]\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000\uFEFF]+', ' ', 'g'),
    E' \t\n\r')
$f$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION uqn_fix.hkm30_search_norm(law text, title text, body text, keywords text[], classification text, chapter text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE AS $f$
  SELECT uqn_fix.hkm30_norm(concat_ws(E'\n', nullif(law,''), nullif(title,''), nullif(body,''), nullif(array_to_string(keywords,' '),''), nullif(classification,''), nullif(chapter,'')))
$f$
SELECT 1/(CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_articles WHERE search_norm <> uqn_fix.hkm30_search_norm("lawName", title, content, keywords, classification, chapter))=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS parity

WITH lv AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (object_id) object_id, verified_status FROM verification WHERE object_type='unit' ORDER BY object_id, verified_at DESC, id DESC),
ev AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (unit_id) unit_id, body FROM unit_version WHERE valid_from <= now() ORDER BY unit_id, valid_from DESC),
t AS (SELECT a.id, a.search_norm old, uqn_fix.hkm30_search_norm(a."lawName", a.title, ev.body, a.keywords, a.classification, a.chapter) new FROM legal_articles a JOIN ev ON ev.unit_id=a.id LEFT JOIN lv ON lv.object_id=a.id WHERE lv.verified_status IS NULL OR lv.verified_status NOT IN ('ملغاة','ملغى'))
SELECT 1/(CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM t)=583 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM t WHERE old IS DISTINCT FROM new)=582 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t WHERE coalesce(new,'')='') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_before

WITH lv AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (object_id) object_id, verified_status FROM verification WHERE object_type='unit' ORDER BY object_id, verified_at DESC, id DESC),
ev AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (unit_id) unit_id, body FROM unit_version WHERE valid_from <= now() ORDER BY unit_id, valid_from DESC),
t AS (SELECT a.id, a.search_norm old, uqn_fix.hkm30_search_norm(a."lawName", a.title, ev.body, a.keywords, a.classification, a.chapter) new FROM legal_articles a JOIN ev ON ev.unit_id=a.id LEFT JOIN lv ON lv.object_id=a.id WHERE lv.verified_status IS NULL OR lv.verified_status NOT IN ('ملغاة','ملغى'))
UPDATE legal_articles a SET search_norm = t.new FROM t WHERE a.id=t.id AND a.search_norm IS DISTINCT FROM t.new

ev AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (unit_id) unit_id, body FROM unit_version WHERE valid_from <= now() ORDER BY unit_id, valid_from DESC),
